content:
Autism Sanctuary is proud to announce that we have received the Charlottesville Business Innovation Council (CBIC) Social Good Award.

This honor recognizes organizations that are making wildly needed and immensely positive changes within our local community. We have been so honored to have the opportunity to run alongside an amazing group of businesses, and are deeply grateful to have been selected for this award. At Autism Sanctuary, our mission is to enhance the lives of those with autism through nature-based activities by fostering community connections and providing personalized support. While we are proud to offer these supports, we can confidently say that it would not be possible without the unwavering support of this community. 

Receiving the CBIC Social Good Award affirms the importance of this work and the impact it is having on our individuals, their families, and the broader community. This award motivates us to continue innovating and growing, so that even more individuals can benefit from the work that we are doing here. 

A very big, heartfelt thanks to CBIC for this recognition and to everyone who has supported Autism Sanctuary along the way. Here's to much more to come!
